specialRules.name: Favored of Iaxxil
specialRules.description: At the start of each game Session, a Merchant has one additional Favor die if it is used for the well-being of Iaxxil's Domains of Power: Gluttony-6, Sadness-2, or War-1. In a temple or place blessed by Iaxxil, the Merchant receives DM +1 for Tests aligned with Iaxxil.
